sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We do not collect any personal information. All documents you scan are stored locally on your device only.

sections.heading: 2. Camera & Storage
sections.body: We request camera and storage permissions solely to scan and save documents on your device.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Services
sections.body: This app does not share any data with third parties.

sections.heading: 4. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy in the future. Continued use of the app means you accept any changes.

sections.heading: 5. Contact
sections.body: For questions, reach us via the Play Store review section.
